arm: G8 guideline (reset-strategy scatter: CHW supply vs OAT)
question: At 99 Elizabeth St, is CHW supply temp reset against OAT? scatter + slope, last week
answer: No OAT-based reset. 672 paired 15-min buckets: all-bucket slope -0.30 K/K (r=-0.16); running subset (chw<=12C, ~31%) flips to +0.29 K/K (r=+0.19) - sign reversal rules out deliberate reset. Not a clean flat setpoint either: CHW supply spans 7.6-16.5C (median 13.2) over a narrow OAT range 14.1-20.3C. Signature is a chiller CYCLING against a roughly fixed leaving-water target (down to ~8-10C running, drifts to ~14-16C idle).

cross_cadence_handling: Anticipated 1-min OAT vs 15-min plant, but both turned out 15-min on the SAME collector 57 -> no cross-cadence alignment needed; 672/672 complete paired buckets. Cross-cadence mechanic NOT exercised.
